title: Painted metal with chips and scratches
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of painted steel worn through in layers: top coat, primer and bare metal at stepped chip edges, scratches cut to the metal, rust and grime, with a metallic map for the exposed steel. Use for machinery, vehicles, containers and railings.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python painted_metal_scratched.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: chipping
parameters.meaning: Share of the paint chipped away.

parameters.name: chip_scale
parameters.meaning: Noise cells across the tile for the chips (higher gives smaller chips).

parameters.name: scratch_direction
parameters.meaning: How strongly scratches follow one direction (0 random, 1 parallel).

parameters.name: grime
parameters.meaning: Dirt and dust over the paint.

parameters.name: paint_gloss
parameters.meaning: Gloss of the top coat (0 flat, 1 glossy enamel).

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Safety yellow over grey primer with chips and scratches.

presets.name: olive_drab
presets.description: Matte military olive drab, heavily scuffed.

presets.name: glossy_red
presets.description: Glossy red enamel with a few fine scratches.

presets.name: machinery_blue
presets.description: Worn blue machinery paint with oily grime.

presets.name: old_tractor
presets.description: Faded green paint flaking off rusty steel.

limits: Chips and scratches are placed by noise and random strokes, not by where a real object wears (edges, handles, contact points); combine the maps with an edge-wear mask from your tool for that. Scratches carry no burr or directional sheen. Rust is a colour and roughness layer without its own relief. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Thresholded, domain-warped fractional Brownian motion as a chip mask
Layer choice by depth inside the chip mask: top coat, primer, bare steel
Capsule strokes painted with wrap-around for scratches
glTF metallic-roughness split between paint and bare steel
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
